structured_output.what_is_happening: "Just a ghost guy" (GHOSTGUY) is a pump.fun coin that launched about 54 minutes ago and moved to PumpSwap about 11 minutes ago. It is trading at about $74-76k market cap with about $23k liquidity, near its all-time high of about $79k. Price is up 23-26% in the last 5 minutes and about 50-65% since migration. Volume is about $61k, or about 2.6x market cap in the first hour. There are more unique buyers (608) than unique sellers (251), but there are far more sell transactions (about 2,130) than buys (about 840). That points to heavy bot or split selling into the post-migration pump.

narrative.description: A generic cute-character meme: a harmless 'just a ghost guy' in the style of 'just a chill guy'. There is no website, only an X account. The description is just the name.
narrative.why_spreading: The attention mostly comes from the pump.fun graduation flow and bots trading the migration. Nothing in the packet shows an outside cultural hook. The 'just a ___ guy' template is worn out but can still pull degen flow.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only pair with liquidity and volume, and it is the graduated version linked to the @GhostguyOnSol X account.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Two dead copies: 'Ghost Guy' (4f3w...pump), created about 19 minutes earlier with $1.2k market cap, and a GHOSTGUY clone (45JF...) at about $7 market cap. Neither has liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Holders are fairly spread: top 10 hold 16.9%, the dev holds 2%, and there are about 1,016 holders. On the other hand, 40% of wallets are fresh, 44 are bundler wallets, 26 are sniper wallets, and the bot/degen rate is 47%. Sell transactions outnumber buys about 2.5 to 1. The project's X account was renamed from MOONOnPump a day ago, and the dev's X account has launched 3 tokens. That looks like a recycled launch account. No paid DexScreener boosts are active, but the DexScreener profile has been paid for and updated. Only 65 GMGN page visits.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I can't tell whether the ghost meme is getting any organic posts.

structural_risks: The X account was recycled from MOONOnPump, and the dev's X account has launched several tokens
The ratio of sell transactions to buys suggests bots distributing into the pump
About $23k liquidity: thin, with sharp swings possible
Price is at its all-time high right after migration, so a retrace risks hitting the -50% stop

structured_output.counterargument: This is a fresh graduation that is breaking to new highs with accelerating 5-minute volume, 244 unique buyers in 5 minutes, burned LP and a spread-out holder base. That is the classic setup for a post-migration run from about $75k to over $150k, and a 2x to about $150k market cap is common for coins that catch degen flow in their first hour on PumpSwap.

structured_output.thesis: This is a typical just-migrated pump.fun meme with momentum. Buyer breadth is decent and holders are fairly spread, but it has a generic name and a recycled X account. The bot and bundler share is high, and bots are heavily selling into the rise. Entering at the all-time high right after migration makes a retrace to the stop about as likely as a 2x. It ranks a little above an average coin in this pool because of the live momentum and breadth, but it is not a standout.
